evidence.ACL: Normal orientation of ACL with intact ligament fiber is observed.
evidence.Medial OA: narrowing of the medial tibiofemoral joint, with full thickness cartilage loss at weightbearing part of the medial femoral condyle
evidence.Lateral OA: Diffuse chondrosis of the lateral femoral condyle and tibial plateau is observed.
evidence.PF OA: Thinning articular cartilage with illdefined hyperintense lesions along medial and lateral PF joint are noted.
evidence.Synovitis: mild thickened synovial tissue are seen.
